description: Illinois Secretary of State - Business Search and New Filings. Search the Illinois Secretary of State business register by company name or 8-digit file number, or (mode=newFilings) list LLCs and corporations newly organized in Illinois between two dates within the last 13 months. Returns entity name, file number, type, status, formation and other dates, registered agent, and managers or officers. Name search matches entities whose name contains all the words; onlyActive keeps entities in good standing. For a daily new-business feed, schedule newFilings with onlyNewSinceLastRun so late-indexed filings arrive exactly once. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

dateFrom.description: New filings only. YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 7 days ago. The last 13 months are available.
dateFrom.title: Organized from

dateTo.description: New filings only. YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today.
dateTo.title: Organized to

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Most entities kept per query (default 50, so a broad word does not bring thousands of records). 0 = up to 1,000.
maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query

mode.description: Search looks up the company names or Illinois file numbers you list. New filings lists the LLCs and corporations organized in Illinois between two dates (the last 13 months) - schedule it daily with "Only entities not delivered before" for a feed.
mode.title: What to do

onlyActive.description: Keep only entities in good standing or reinstated.
onlyActive.title: Only active entities

onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: New filings only. Skips entities this feed already delivered, so a daily schedule with a 7-day window catches late-registered filings exactly once.
onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only entities not delivered before

searchQueries.description: Company names or 8-digit Illinois file numbers, one per line. A name matches every entity whose name contains all its words ("LLC", "Inc" and similar endings are ignored, except that an exact full name is listed first).
searchQueries.title: Search queries

stateStoreName.description: New filings only. Key-value store in your Apify account that remembers what was delivered. Use a different name for each independent feed.
stateStoreName.title: Feed memory store name

name: regdata_illinois_sos_business
